description.value:
Trigger A creature attempts to manipulate any of the door's gears other than to simultaneously turn three tripartite key amulets counterclockwise from the depressions at the center of the trap's three massive gears, or any attempt is made to [[/act force-open]] or damage the doors themselves

Effect All of the doors' gears grind and spin in a pattern designed to emit an ear-splitting cacophony of twisting metal and screaming mechanisms. Any creature within 40 feet of the door must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Deafened] for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[3d6[sonic]] damage and is deafened for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[sonic]] damage and is deafened for 1 hour.

details.description: Three massive gears stand out amid a chaotic array of smaller gears that virtually make up the entire surface of a set of enormous double doors. Tiny slots at the center of each of the massive gears perfectly match the prongs that emerge from the converse of one of the clan's tripartite key amulets.
details.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26] (expert) to jam the gears into place, preventing the trap from using Screaming Gears (and simultaneously jamming the door shut); a critical success unlocks the doors without the tripartite key
details.reset: The trap ceases its grinding shriek at the end of the round and immediately resets.
